newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.

Vessels: Sea Chariot loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Elina III loading 24,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, four vessels to load bagged sugar. Road: 202 trucks carrying sugar arrived between Aug 15 and 17.

Vessels: Unisea, Phaeton and Janbaz 1 each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Tia Angelica loading 12,250 tonnes bagged sugar. Maro to load 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mayprince loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Pantaziz L loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Symplea loading 13,125 tonnes bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, six vessels to load sugar (unspecified). At Cargill private terminal, A.Alamdar loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bulk sugar and one to load sugar (unspecified).
Loading (Aug 17): 1,827 tonnes bagged sugar, 3,092 tonnes bulk.
